connections.description: External connections, one values layer per projects/<project>/connections/<name>.yaml.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

memoryGi.title: Memory (GiB)
memoryGi.description: Memory limit of the Polaris server in GiB. The request is 512Mi.

db.title: Metadata database
db.description: Connection to the PostgreSQL server hosting the Polaris metastore database.

realm.title: Realm
realm.description: Polaris realm served by this instance. Clients select it with the Polaris-Realm header, and the catalog Connection publishes it. Letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen only.

principals.title: Principals
principals.description: Polaris principals to create in the realm, with their principal roles, one entry per principal, for example [{"name": "alice", "roles": ["catalog_admin"]}]. Names and roles: letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen only. Humans and service accounts authenticate through the platform identity provider and get the roles granted here.

storage.title: Object store
storage.description: Connection to the S3-compatible object store backing the catalogs.

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: Secret with keys accessKey/secretKey, this consumer's own S3 identity (STS and catalog-side Iceberg metadata operations).

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream charts this chart renders, one object per chart, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

polaris.title: polaris
polaris.description: Values of the polaris chart 1.3.0-incubating (https://downloads.apache.org/polaris/helm-chart/), for example image, resources, replicaCount, nodeSelector, tolerations, advancedConfig, features, authentication.tokenBroker. Refused: fullnameOverride, service.ports, persistence, storage, realmContext, authentication.type/authenticator/realmOverrides, oidc, ingress.enabled/className/hosts/tls, serviceMonitor. Appended to the lists this chart sets: extraEnv, extraVolumes, extraVolumeMounts, cors.allowedOrigins.

polaris-console.title: polaris-console
polaris-console.description: Values of the polaris-console chart 0.2.0 (oci://quay.io/okdp/charts/polaris-console): image, resources, replicaCount, extra extraEnv variables, ... Refused: fullnameOverride, env.polarisApiUrl/polarisRealm/oauthTokenUrl, extraEnv.VITE_OIDC_ISSUER_URL/VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID/VITE_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI/VITE_OIDC_SCOPE, ingress.enabled/className/hosts/tls.

polaris-admin.title: polaris-admin
polaris-admin.description: Values of the polaris-admin chart 1.0.0 (oci://quay.io/okdp/charts/polaris-admin), applied to both its Jobs (bootstrap and principals): bootstrap.image, principals.image, backoffLimit, ttlSecondsAfterFinished, extraEnv, extraVolumes, ... Refused: fullnameOverride, phase, realms, bootstrap.purge, bootstrap.database, bootstrap.annotations, principals.polaris.url, principals.annotations.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
